excerpt: Built for High Resolution, High Efficiency, and High Reliability Seismic Acquisition with Less Operational Cost and Environmental Impact

sections.title: Product Highlights
bullets: Optional KCK version for external geophone string;
24-bit Δ-Σ ADC converter for high-resolution, high-dynamic-range seismic signal recording;
Configurable sample rate and preamplifier gain;
Highly sensitive GNSS module equipped with active patch antenna supports GPS, Beidou, and GLONASS;
Intermittent GNSS clock synchronization strategy, with timing accuracy less than ±10μs;
Internal lithium-ion battery pack supports seismic recording for up to 800 hours;

Built-in test signal generator supports on-site full signal chain function and performance self-inspection and diagnosis, including system noise, real-time dynamic range, geophone impedance, natural frequency, sensitivity, damping, distortion, etc.;

BLE module together with visual LEDs for on-site configuration and proximity. Ground communication distance around 20 meters, air communication distance over 100 meters, supports vehicle or UAV patrol;
P&R (Place & Record) mode for rapid and convenient in-field deployment, supporting automatic GNSS position matching with line and point number;
Industrial Android tablet supports working status verification after deployment, including battery autonomy, environmental temperature, tilting, ambient noise, real-time seismic waveform, etc.;
High-strength engineering plastic enclosure for enhanced drop resistance, waterproof (IP68), flame retardant (5VA), ultraviolet aging (F1);
Compact volume (9.8L x 10.8W x 11H cm) and light weight (750g) for convenient transportation and deployment.
